exclusions_not_holding.part: BQ28Z610DRZR (and the BQ28Z610 family, JLCPCB C157573)
exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: 1-2 series gauge with data-flash CUV; behaviour with an open cell tap and a charger-gated CUV release not found in the datasheet read (SLUSAS3D, 11:47:38Z); its TRM not read. Not shown to meet 'balance lead open'
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The charger-gated release is in the TRM P2 did not read, so half of the reason does not hold. BQ28Z610 TRM SLUUA65E (June 2023), https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/SLUUA65 (final URL https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/sluua65e/sluua65e.pdf), vendors.py fetch read 2026-10-02T12:19:12Z. Section 2.2 and 13.10.1: CUV Threshold 0 to 32767 mV (default 2500 mV), CUV Delay 0 to 255 s (default 2 s, so at least 89 ms), CUV Recovery 0 to 32767 mV (default 3000 mV); with Protection Configuration[CUV_RECOV_CHG] = 1 the trip clears only when min cell voltage is at or above CUV:Recovery AND charging is detected (BatteryStatus()[DSG] = 0). That is the same release P2 credits to the BQ40Z80, in a 1-to-2-series part (SLUSAS3D 8.1). So 'reconnect condition' (charger present and every cell at or above 3.2 V, never on the load returning) is met with Recovery 3200 mV and CUV_RECOV_CHG = 1. Other values read: ISHUTDOWN 0.5 uA typical, 2 uA maximum, ISLEEP 100 uA typical (SLUSAS3D 7.5), so the 10 uA limit holds only in SHUTDOWN, entered by voltage-based, MAC or AUTO_SHIP_EN time-based shutdown (TRM 5.4) and left when PACK exceeds VSTARTUP (2.25 V typical, 2.45 V maximum, 7.3); whether the CUV trip survives that reset is not read. VC2 recommended 2.2 V to 26 V; cell inputs VC1 and VC2-VC1 up to 5 V (7.3). Current: sense resistor 1 mOhm to 3 mOhm (8.4.2.3), hardware ASCD thresholds to -100 mV (RSNS = 0) or -200 mV (RSNS = 1) (TRM Appendix A.3), so 60 A is 60 mV at 1 mOhm; the OCD threshold in data flash is in mA with a +/-32.767 A field and has to be disabled or set. Still open and not read: the voltage-ADC accuracy (the datasheet gives only the scaling factor K 0.198 to 0.202, +/-1 %, which is +/-30 mV at 3.0 V, and no voltage offset or gain figure) against the +/-75 mV; and open-lead behaviour (SLUSAS3D 8.2 shows a 'Cell Detach Detection' block with no behaviour text, the TRM has only the VIMR and VIMA imbalance permanent failures, and unlike the BQ40Z80 datasheet it lists no open-cell failure). 'Balance lead open' therefore rests on the same pull-down inference as P2's rank 3 BQ4050RSMR, which P2 kept. JLCPCB C157573 stockCount 6814, canPresaleNumber 6795, expand, USD 1.9004 at 10, SON-12-EP 2.5 x 4 mm (vendors.py jlcpcb C157573, 2026-10-02T12:36:48Z) against BQ40Z80RSMR 8611 and USD 2.2776 at 10 (12:36:54Z). Digi-Key not read, because not every value is shown to pass. Siblings: BQ28Z610DRZR-R1 C2876556 219/212 at USD 2.6141 at 10 (12:36:51Z); BQ28Z620DRZR C20345237 64/64 at USD 6.1759 at 10 (12:36:49Z), Digi-Key 0 per another agent's reading at 12:27:41Z. The drop should read 'not shown for open lead and voltage accuracy', not 'no charger-gated release'.
